name: adt-mcp
description: Work with SAP ABAP systems through the adt-mcp MCP server. USE WHEN the user wants to read or write ABAP source code, activate objects, run unit tests or ATC checks, manage transports, or explore the ABAP repository via the MCP server. Trigger words – get source, update source, activate, check syntax, run unit tests, list package objects, search objects, transport request, ATC.
